thread:
Ruth (PM): quick check-in — customer asks for private tenant with HSM keywrap and a staged rollout. timeline: 3 weeks. Can we validate capacity, security gating, and a runtime fallback plan? @Nate @Aria @Priya @Omar

Nate (Eng): short: HSM connector + acceptance tests is roughly 8 dev days + 2 days QA. if we fold quantization into the same sprint, quality risk increases.

Aria (Runtime): runtime notes: quantized variants are supported but we'd need to benchmark perf when behind HSM (latency jitter). Recommend initial launch with unquantized to reduce unknowns. KV cache + batching can offset cost.

Priya (Infra): infra constraints: private staging needs separate subnet and VPN peering. I can stand up nodes for a 72h soak if we get the exact GPU shape. earliest window is week of Apr 19. Need customer ip allowlist and service account details.

Omar (Security): we can prioritise the review if design doc + threat model hit inbox within 48 hours. HSM leads to audit log + key rotation checklist. Also need export-control signoff.

Jin (ProdOps): proposed launch criteria: 1) p95 < 250ms on auth+small-response flow, 2) no F1 drop on eval suite >1.5%, 3) security acceptance, 4) rollback playbook validated. rollout: alpha(1%) -> beta(10%) -> prod(100%) with 1h observation gates.

Ruth (PM): trade-off: customer prefers HSM day 1, but they may accept HSM after initial private rollout. Options: (A) wait 2 more weeks for HSM day1, (B) launch private without HSM then flip to HSM in a patch. thoughts?

Nate (Eng): vote for B. avoids slipping the overall customer onboarding. we'll need a migration plan for key-wrapping and a toggled connector.

Aria (Runtime): agree with B. runtime can dual-write cache layers during migration. We should add traffic shaping to avoid cache storms during switch.

Priya (Infra): I'll schedule the prewarm: 72h, target qps 60, model: unquantized-v2. Need a ticket with exact instance types and peering info.

infra-bot: Ticket created: INF-9123 private-tenant-prewarm — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-9123

Omar (Security): action: once doc lands I'll raise SR-flag and attach compliance reviewers. add Lena (Compliance) as reviewer.

Jin (ProdOps): rollout safeguard: automatic rollback if error-rate > 1.5% OR p95 increases 40% over baseline. Suggest synthetic canary checks every 5m.

Ruth (PM): Action list: 1) Ruth to publish design doc + migration plan by EOD tomorrow, 2) Nate + Aria pair on connector plan, 3) Priya to reserve infra for Apr19 window, 4) Omar to queue fast-track review. Reconvene Tue 10:30. Thanks :rocket:
